evals.name: fresh-start-from-plan
evals.prompt: The expense-tracker tasktracker project has phases ready (5 phases, no implementation started yet). Start implementing. Pause between phases for confirmation.
evals.expected_output: Agent calls listProjects → getProjectReadiness → getPrinciples → listTasks (type=phase), identifies phase 1 as the first non-completed, calls setActiveTask + updateTaskStatus(in_progress) on it, then DELEGATES to /implement-phase (does NOT write code itself), pauses for user confirmation when phase 1 finishes, repeats for phase 2.

assertions.text: Agent calls tasktracker_getPrinciples before starting phase work
Agent calls tasktracker_setActiveTask on the phase task
Agent calls tasktracker_updateTaskStatus to mark phase in_progress
Agent invokes /implement-phase skill (does not write code directly)
Agent does NOT use Write, Edit, or NotebookEdit tools
Agent calls tasktracker_pauseActiveTask before the user-confirmation message
Agent waits for user confirmation before starting phase 2

evals.name: resume-mid-phase
evals.prompt: Resume implementing the expense-tracker plan. Phases 1 and 2 are completed; phase 3 was in_progress when the previous session ended.
evals.expected_output: Agent calls listTasks (type=phase), correctly identifies phase 3 as the resume point (in_progress), shows a status table to the user, sets active task on phase 3, and continues from there. Does NOT redo phases 1 or 2.

assertions.text: Agent calls tasktracker_listTasks filtering for phase type
Agent identifies phase 3 as the resume point
Agent displays a status summary showing 1, 2 completed and 3 in-progress
Agent calls setActiveTask on phase 3 (not phase 1 or 2)
Agent does NOT mark phase 1 or 2 as in_progress again

evals.name: blocker-during-phase
evals.prompt: Continue with phase 4 of expense-tracker. /implement-phase has just returned PHASE_RESULT.status: BLOCKED with this issue: 'Existing CSV parser in src/legacy/csv.js conflicts with planned implementation'. Options it returned: A) New implementation, mark legacy for removal; B) Refactor legacy; C) Abort and revise plan.
evals.expected_output: Agent STOPS phase execution, presents the blocker + 3 options + a recommendation to the user, and AWAITS user decision. Does NOT auto-pick an option. Does NOT mark the phase as completed. If the user picks C (abort/revise), agent creates a new follow-up phase via createTask rather than editing the blocked phase's description.

assertions.text: Agent halts phase execution on receiving BLOCKED
Agent presents all 3 options to the user with a recommendation
Agent does NOT mark the phase as completed
Agent does NOT attempt to update the blocked phase's description
If user picks 'revise plan', agent creates a NEW phase task via tasktracker_createTask rather than editing the existing one
Agent waits for user input before proceeding
